header: A named person as the way in
author: The author field holds the name
role: The role field holds the function
text: Portrait, name, role, one line about what this person handles and two actions for calling or writing. The name is the card's heading, so the person can be found in a heading list.
note: The portrait takes an empty alt — the name is the next thing announced, and 'photograph of' before it is only in the way.
